d: Most fitness advice assumes everyone responds the same way, when people are really starting from very different starting points ("body types"). How to lose fat and how to build muscle slightly differs depending on what starting point you're at. In this video, we also break down common questions like “what body type am I” and how to determine your body type, where somatotype ideas fit in, and how that affects muscle growth. We'll cover "how to fix skinny fat", and more!
